name: GEC King Edward
address: 431 W King Edward Avenue, Vancouver, British Columbia BC V5Y 2J3
about:
GEC King Edward student apartments are located in the Westside of Vancouver, just a 3-minute walk to King Edward SkyTrain station, making it convenient for students to easily access major universities and the downtown area. With a range of amenities nearby, including Elizabeth Queen Park and Hillcrest Community Centre (featuring facilities like a swimming pool, library, and ice rink), as well as abundant dining, shopping, and entertainment options, your convenience is greatly enhanced. It's only a 15-minute SkyTrain ride to Langara College. Nearby schools include Edith Cavell Elementary Secondary, Eric Hamber Secondary, Sir Winston Churchill Secondary, as well as private schools like York House School, Little Flower Academy, Vancouver College.
GEC LIVING is the largest off-campus student apartment in Vancouver, providing high-quality accommodation for over 5000 students annually. We collaborate with multiple renowned institutions and have received recommendations from over 70 organizations. We are committed to creating a safe, comfortable, and convenient living environment for international and local students, making the study abroad experience worry-free!Fully serviced apartments, move-in ready
